title: Fall in Love with Her
overview: Fall in Love with Her follows Lola, a musician deeply in love and on the brink of a creative breakthrough, as she begins to question whether the life she's building truly belongs to her. When love and ambition start pulling in different directions, Lola must confront what it means to choose herself and what it might cost. An intimate, emotionally resonant drama about timing, identity, and the quiet decisions that shape a life.
